options.content:
[打开 CLS 查看最近失败 API 5xx](https://console.cloud.tencent.com/cls/search?region=ap-beijing&topic_id=7af98669-1a34-4f37-b60a-431c41f69794&time=now-24h,now&timeZone=browser&queryBase64=bXNnOiJodHRwIHJlcXVlc3QiIEFORCBzdGF0dXNfY29kZTpbNTAwIFRPICpd&hideTopNav=true&hideLeftNav=true&hideTopicSelect=true)

查询语句：
`msg:"http request" AND status_code:[500 TO *]`

默认打开最近 `24h` 时间范围。

[打开 CLS 查看最近失败异步任务](https://console.cloud.tencent.com/cls/search?region=ap-beijing&topic_id=7af98669-1a34-4f37-b60a-431c41f69794&time=now-24h,now&timeZone=browser&queryBase64=bXNnOiJ0YXNrIHRlcm1pbmFsIHN0YXRlIiBBTkQgKHRhc2tfc3RhdGU6IkZBSUxFRCIgT1IgdGFza19zdGF0ZToiUEFSVElBTF9GQUlMRUQiKQ&hideTopNav=true&hideLeftNav=true&hideTopicSelect=true)

查询语句：
`msg:"task terminal state" AND (task_state:"FAILED" OR task_state:"PARTIAL_FAILED")`

若 CLS 中无结果，说明当前时间范围内暂无失败样本。

[打开 CLS 查看最近失败 Bypass](https://console.cloud.tencent.com/cls/search?region=ap-beijing&topic_id=7af98669-1a34-4f37-b60a-431c41f69794&time=now-24h,now&timeZone=browser&&hideTopNav=true&hideLeftNav=true&hideTopicSelect=true)

查询语句：
`bypass_name:* AND (msg:"resend task to mq failed" OR msg:"check task lock failed, skip resend" OR msg:"task reached max_execute_count but lock still held, skip resend" OR msg:"lock bypass failed" OR msg:"bypass runFunc panic recovered")`

若 CLS 中无结果，说明当前时间范围内暂无失败样本。
